extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology record; direct mechanism was not experimentally tested, so mechanistic statements are capped at phenotypic or inferred evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TtAP-1 shows rapid bactericidal activity in time-kill assays at 1x MIC against A. baumannii and S. aureus.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This supports rapid killing phenotype but does not directly identify the molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper infers possible bacterial membrane integrity disruption from rapid killing and peptide physicochemical properties, while explicitly stating that mechanism was not directly investigated.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: TtAP-1, with broader discussion of TtAP peptides
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote this to direct membrane permeabilization evidence; no membrane-permeability assay was performed for TtAP-1 in this paper.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TtAP peptides have measurable hemolytic activity against mouse erythrocytes, limiting anti-infective therapeutic potential for TtAP-1.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is toxicity context, not an antimicrobial mechanism claim.
